items.text: The publicly available HypoTermQA Benchmarking Dataset is introduced to benchmark the hallucination tendency of LLMs and evaluate hallucination detection.
Generalization across benchmarks and LLMs remains challenging when using probing-based classifiers that utilize LLMs' internal representations for hallucination detection.
EvoMoE introduces the Dynamic Token-aware Router (DTR), a routing mechanism that allocates input tokens to experts based on their modality and intrinsic token values.

The AI-Catcher detection method integrates a multilayer perceptron to learn the feature representations of linguistic and statistical features and a convolutional neural network to extract sequential patterns.
Paper [1] presents a categorization of prompt injections to guide future research and act as a checklist of vulnerabilities in LLM interface development.

Paper [2] establishes RobustBench as a standardized benchmark of adversarial robustness for image classification, featuring a leaderboard that evaluates 120+ models on well-defined tasks in l_infinity- and l_2-threat models and on common corruptions.
Three main challenges to federated learning include non-i.i.d. node data, high communication overhead between peers, and client heterogeneity regarding dataset bias and size [4].

A feature alignment-based knowledge distillation strategy transfers knowledge from large pre-trained models into lightweight student models, significantly reducing computational overhead and storage requirements.
Paper [3] evaluates representative CNN models such as AlexNet alongside Vision Transformers (ViT) using the UC Merced Land Use and EuroSAT Land Use datasets.

The DCD (Domain-Collection-Document) architecture uses a hierarchical decomposition of the information space and multi-stage routing based on structured model outputs to control query processing and retrieval scopes.
XSemPLR is a unified benchmark for cross-lingual semantic parsing featuring 22 natural languages and 8 meaning representations covering 5 tasks and 164 domains.
Defensive distillation reduces the effectiveness of adversarial sample creation from 95% to less than 0.5% on a studied DNN.
Falcon achieved perfect precision and zero hallucinations, but at the cost of the lowest recall and the highest response deviation.

The feature-oriented regulation method Psi-Net ensures explicit feature information allocation in different neural network structures to achieve model alignment and maintain convergence speed and accuracy in heterogeneous federated settings.

TweetEval Irony and Sarcasm Corpus V2 are utilized as benchmark datasets for evaluating sarcasm detection.

FLBench is a federated learning benchmark suite that contains medical, financial, and AIoT domains to evaluate aspects like privacy-preserving and data distribution heterogeneity.
Chain-of-Thought reasoning writes steps as text and follows one reasoning path at a time, limiting the capabilities of Large Language Models.

Existing machine learning and deep learning phishing webpage detection models like Stack model, VisualPhishNet, and Phishpedia remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, showing a significant drop in detection rates when evaluated against tool-generated adversarial webpages.
Auto-Encoders and Deep Neural Networks with varying layers are used in a deep learning-based malware detection system evaluated on the Malicia dataset.
Search-Augmented Factuality Evaluator (SAFE) uses an LLM to break down long-form responses into individual facts and evaluate their accuracy using Google Search results.
Paper [1] establishes a comprehensive robustness benchmark called ARES-Bench on the image classification task to evaluate the robustness of 55 typical deep learning models on ImageNet.

Vision transformers typically require greater computational resources and larger training datasets than CNNs to achieve optimal performance, while CNNs perform robustly on datasets with limited training samples.
Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation (CRAG) exhibits key failure modes including domain transfer limitations on science questions.
A two-tier transformer architecture is chosen to encode morphological information at the inputs for low-resource neural machine translation.

Paper [3] investigates supervised algorithms including Artificial Neural Network, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, Linear Discriminant Analysis, and K-Nearest Neighbors, as well as unsupervised algorithms like K-means, Mean-shift, and DBSCAN for anomaly-based Intrusion Detection Systems.
Paper [1] presents a federated learning workflow that incorporates anonymization and differential privacy techniques with personalized privacy budgets.

CoI-tuning fine-tunes large language models with compositional instructions where the output of one instruction becomes the input for the next like a chain.

The MegaVul benchmark is used for evaluating models on vulnerability datasets, where mono achieved a correction of 31.0% of labeling errors.

For machine-generated text detection in Urdu, linguistic and statistical analysis focused on features such as character and word counts, Type Token Ratio vocabulary richness, and N-gram patterns.
